capabilities: Build nested AND/OR/NOT queries over tags, frontmatter, body text, names, paths, and dates
Apply bulk frontmatter, tag, and body operations including regex find-and-replace and blank-line cleanup
Preview changes with impact summaries, regex match previews, and dry-run diffs before applying
Back up changed files per run and undo with drift detection and git-style diffs
Export run reports as Markdown notes with a unified diff per file
extras: Installable via BRAT; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns the default backup folder inside .obsidian/plugins may not sync and can be deleted on reinstall, recommending a vault-internal backupFolder.
problem: Obsidian's search can find notes but cannot apply the same edit across many files at once, and doing it by hand is slow and error-prone.
summary: Bulk editor that finds notes with a visual AND/OR query builder and applies frontmatter, tag, and body edit operations with backups and undo.
